reviewNotes: Fixed preliminary candidate for the documented 3.28 kW peak / 24.08 kWh daily / 19.68 kWh backup scenario. Picon estimate: 8 × 5.12 kWh = 40.96 kWh nominal; at existing 70% DoD × 85% DC-to-AC planning factors this is 24.37 kWh estimated AC energy. This is an estimate, not manufacturer-stated usable AC energy.

PV layout screened as 9 modules in series on each of 2 MPPTs: 18 × 585 W = 10.53 kWp nameplate. It is below Deye 12.0 kW PV access limit, while the 9.6 kW conversion input limit may clip power. At 10°C the nominal temperature-adjusted string Voc is approximately 492.1 V; Jinko does not state a Voc production tolerance, so the 500 V maximum cannot be confirmed and this configuration must not be presented as electrically approved.

Per string: STC Imp 13.29 A < 18 A MPPT input; Isc × Picon 1.25 screening factor = 17.51 A < 27 A MPPT short-circuit limit. Derived hot Vmp uses STC and NOCT Vmp only as a planning estimate; it is not manufacturer-certified. Confirm exact installed panel batch voltage tolerance and site/design temperatures before installation.

Battery quantity is within Deye parallel limit. Inverter charge setting is capped at 135 A (inverter max); 8 × SE-F5 aggregate charge capability is 400 A. Manufacturer-approved inverter/battery pairing is documented, but complete installation design is not approved.

Required balance-of-system scope remains unpriced / site-dependent: external battery breaker and disconnect, PV string DC isolation and surge-protected junction/combiner enclosure, two separate 40 A AC breakers, distribution/RCD/branch protection, panel mounting structure, PV and battery cabling/connectors, earthing/bonding and termination hardware. No arbitrary quantities, offers or prices are assumed.

Exact Nigerian panel supplier offer (model + new condition + current stock) and a complete current priced materials bill are unavailable. Do not show a numerical system price until all required component prices are verified.

equipmentRequirements.name: External battery over-current protection and isolator
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Deye requires external battery over-current protection/disconnect; final rating and cable coordination are selected by the designer.

equipmentRequirements.name: PV string DC isolation / over-current protection
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: One protected string path for each inverter MPPT; exact DC ratings and enclosure must match the final design.

equipmentRequirements.name: PV surge-protection enclosure / junction box
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Confirm coordination with the inverter-integrated Type II SPD and the final site earthing design.

equipmentRequirements.name: AC input and backup-output two-pole breakers
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Deye manual recommends separate 40 A breakers for the 6 kW inverter; final interrupting rating and installation are site checked.

equipmentRequirements.name: AC distribution board with RCD / branch protection
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Board ways, residual-current protection, circuit count and ratings depend on the property circuits.

equipmentRequirements.name: PV mounting structure and module clamps
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: One module position per panel; rail spans, roof type, wind loading and fasteners need the site survey.

equipmentRequirements.name: PV cable, connectors and string terminations
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Two PV strings; exact conductor lengths and connector compatibility depend on array/inverter routing.

equipmentRequirements.name: Battery interconnect and inverter DC cable set
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Use the Deye manual cable cross-section recommendation; length, lug type and eight-unit parallel distribution need the final layout.

equipmentRequirements.name: Protective earthing and bonding
equipmentRequirements.selectionNote: Earthing electrode, conductor size and bonding are determined from site electrical conditions and local code.
